//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the table-container — the bare, card-less framed wrapper around a table (border + rounded corners + horizontal scroll on overflow). NEUTRAL scenarios + the GOLDEN markup core blesses. CONTAINER-ONLY: the inner <table class="pa-table"> arrives via the text slot and is covered by table.json, so pa-table* is deferred there. The DEPRECATED panel mode (pa-table-container--panel + __header/__title/__actions, deprecated core 2.9.0-rc10 as a near-duplicate of pa-table-card) is legacy tolerance, NOT a blessed shape — it is deferred (cssStateClasses / deferred), not modelled as a scenario (rigidity-over-flexibility: one canonical shape per component). See ../README.md, table.json / table-card.json (siblings) for the model.

propsVocabulary.content: inner table markup — rendered verbatim into the container (a text slot here)

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet shape (snippets/tables.html): a bare <div class="pa-table-container"> wrapping a table. Container-only: the inner table is a text slot and pa-table* is covered by table.json, so it is deferred there. No attribute conventions are added. The deprecated panel form is not exercised. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away; goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `produces: null` = structural/native. The container's only blessed class is the base pa-table-container (no blessed modifier — --panel is deprecated, see cssStateClasses).

content.note: structural — inner table; pa-table is covered by table.json

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-table-container--* modifier(s) in main.css that are NOT blessed features. --panel is DEPRECATED (core 2.9.0-rc10, near-duplicate of pa-table-card); both wrappers still render it as legacy tolerance but it is not a documented option, so it is claimed here rather than modelled as a scenario.
cssStateClasses.pa-table-container--panel: DEPRECATED panel styling with a header row — superseded by pa-table-card; legacy tolerance only

deferred.//: pa-table-container__* elements belong to the DEPRECATED panel form only (never emitted in the blessed card-less container). Acknowledged out-of-scope (prose, unverified) — they are legacy tolerance, superseded by pa-table-card's header/title/actions. NOTE one known wrapper divergence in this deprecated form: keen emits __title as <h3>, svelte as <div> — intentionally not reconciled because the shape is deprecated.
